# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is the working plan for [greta](https://greta-dev.github.io/greta/), an R
package for statistical modelling: what is being worked on, in what order, and
why.

It is written mostly for the maintainer — a place to put the reasoning behind a
decision so it can be picked up again months later — and partly for anyone who
wants to see where greta is going without reading the whole issue tracker.

@sec-plan is the overview: thirteen milestones covering every open issue, in
release order. One chapter per milestone follows, so milestone *n* is chapter
*n* + 1. Each chapter says what the milestone is for and how its issues relate,
then gives a block per issue: the date it was filed, its labels, the finding,
the proposed fix, and a priority.

Anything niche about a particular issue — a disputed diagnosis, a resolved
tie-break, a correction to an earlier proposed fix — lives with that issue
rather than in a chapter of its own. Every issue number links to GitHub.

Two appendices cover the packages with their own release tracks:
`greta.distributions`, and `greta.checks` (@sec-greta-checks).

This is not a promise about what will ship or when. Where this book and the
issue tracker disagree, the tracker wins.
